title: Set Up Business Central Data Mirroring to Microsoft Fabric

facts.text: Data mirroring setup is in preview and requires the Microsoft Fabric Mirroring extension on a compatible Business Central online environment.
Your user must have the MS Fabric Mirroring - Admin permission set or equivalent permissions in Business Central.
The Fabric destination workspace must be assigned to an active capacity, and you must have at least Member role in it.
The Fabric workspace must be in the same Microsoft Entra tenant as your Business Central environment.
Create an open mirrored database in Microsoft Fabric by signing in, selecting the workspace, opening Create, selecting Mirrored Database and Other, then entering a name.
Business Central uses the Microsoft-provided Dynamics 365 Business Central Fabric Export application (client ID dcc80069-ba40-4ad9-ba8c-60001cea3497) for authentication.
Create a service principal for the app in your Microsoft Entra tenant using Azure Cloud Shell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph PowerShell, or Graph Explorer.
Grant the service principal at least Contributor access to the Fabric workspace either during Business Central setup or directly in Fabric.
